name: EfficientGS
definition: An optimized adaptation of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) designed for efficient large-scale, high-resolution scene representation. It reduces redundancy in 3DGS to alleviate computational and storage demands without sacrificing quality.
summary: EfficientGS optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting for large-scale scenes by reducing redundancy through selective densification and pruning, yielding a model ten times smaller than vanilla 3DGS while maintaining high rendering quality.
